jd:
IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

Position

We are currently hiring interns to join our IG Wealth Management AI Internship Program this winter (January – April) in our Toronto or Winnipeg office locations. As part of this inaugural program, interns will work alongside Senior Leaders across IG to help embed AI-driven capabilities into real business strategies and initiatives.

In a supportive and collaborative environment, interns are empowered with ownership over their work, gaining hands-on experience managing projects and presenting outcomes to senior stakeholders. If you’re passionate about the financial services industry, bring strong technical skills, and enjoy problem-solving and innovation, this program offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while you learn.

This opportunity is open to undergraduate students who will be returning to school after the internship. This is a full-time position requiring 37.5 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Candidates must be eligible to work full-time for the entire duration of the program.

Intern placement will work within the Technology team, with regular touchpoints with one of the following departments to support their AI initiatives: Financial Planning, Sales & Distribution, Investment Solutions, Investment Strategy, Mortgage, Insurance & Banking, Strategy, Advisor & Client Experience, and Private Company Advisory.

Responsibilities



- Work on real AI and automation projects that support business teams and leaders
- Partner with cross‑functional teams to explore how AI can improve processes, decisions, and client experience
- Break down business problems to turn ideas into AI use cases, improved business workflows, and agentic solutions
- Follow AI SDLC process to deliver agentic solutions that are secure, efficient and scalable
- Research new AI tools, trends, and use cases and share key insights with the team
- Support data preparation and analysis workflows to enable AI and analytics initiatives
- Assist with testing, documentation, and improvement of AI tools or process enhancements
- Create demos and track delivery of key work items to share progress and results with senior leaders
- Participate in team meetings, workshops, and learning sessions
- Contribute ideas that improve efficiency and support continuous improvement

Requirements



- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program and returning to school following the internship (e.g., Business, Commerce, Computer Science, Data, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field)
- Demonstrate interest and experience in AI tools, emerging technologies, and their application in business, particularly within financial services
- Demonstrate experience with Python; exposure to AI development or SDLC delivery an asset
- Comfortable working with data, tools, or technology to solve problems
- Curious, proactive, and excited to learn new concepts and technologies
- Able to work independently while collaborating with teammates
- Clear communicator who can explain ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Organized, motivated, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines

To apply, please include a resume and transcripts (full unofficial version) by October 30, 2026, at 11:59 pm EST.

The expected annual base salary range (prorated for the term) for this role is $44,000 - $51,000, which is determined based on year of study, IGM program, geographic location and candidate’s skills, knowledge and experience. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for paid time off.

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

IG is an accessible employer committed to providing a barrier- free recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.ig.ca/en/careers

We thank all applicants for their interest in IG Wealth Management; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jd:
LinkedIn is the worlds largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. Were also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture thats built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun where everyone can succeed.



Job Description


This internship role will be based out of Headquarters in Mountain View, California.



At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.


LinkedIn is looking for Undergraduate Software Engineering Interns to learn, grow, and work with some of the brightest technical talent. As the engineering landscape evolves, we are developing the next generation of technical talent with  strong computer science fundamentals, and the engineering judgment to build impactful products and platforms. Interns may work on advanced information-retrieval algorithms, massive-scale infrastructure and storage solutions, and large-scale applications for users across web and mobile devices. 


You may contribute to data-heavy platforms and applications, including next-generation data infrastructure for storage, streams, media, and analytics. You will help scale LinkedIn infrastructure to support massive data growth across the LinkedIn ecosystem and work with distributed systems, algorithms, caching, queuing, and distributed data storage. You may also use modern AI-powered development tools and emerging technologies to accelerate experimentation, debugging, and technical problem-solving while applying engineering judgment to validate and improve solutions. 


This internship offers the opportunity to strengthen systems-oriented skills, including multithreading, concurrency, scalability, and performance, and to work on cutting-edge open-source systems. You will collaborate with engineers, receive feedback, and participate in LinkedIn’s broader intern community while exploring how AI and emerging technologies are changing software development. 


Candidates must be enrolled in an undergraduate degree program and have an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later. 


Our internships are 12 weeks in length and will have the option of two intern sessions: 


• May 24th, 2027 - August 13th, 2027

• June 14th, 2027 - September 3rd, 2027


Responsibilities:



- Scale distributed applications and make architectural tradeoffs using synchronous and asynchronous design patterns. Write code that delivers speed and quality. Apply AI-powered development tools where appropriate to accelerate experimentation and implementation while maintaining engineering rigor. 
- Develop multi-tier, scalable, high-volume, high-performance, and reliable user-centric applications that operate 24x7. 
- Produce high-quality software with unit-tested, code-reviewed work checked regularly for continuous integration. 
- Evaluate technical solutions, test assumptions, and apply engineering judgement to validate and improve solutions before integration. 
- Apply strong computer science fundamentals and engineering judgment to complex, real-world challenges at scale. 
- Partner with engineers, mentors, and cross-functional teammates to exchange feedback and deepen technical skills. 

Qualifications


Basic Qualifications 



- Pursuing a B.A. or B.S. degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and returning to the program after completion of the internship. 
- Programming experience in Java, C, C++, C#, Python, Rust, Ruby, or a similar object-oriented programming language. 
- Knowledge of core computer science concepts, object-oriented design, algorithm design, data structures, problem-solving, and complexity analysis. 


Preferred Qualifications 



- Experience working in a short-cycle, agile, and iterative development team. 
- Strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, software design, and object-oriented programming. 
- Experience building, testing, debugging, or scaling software applications or systems through coursework, internships, research, hackathons, open-source contributions, or personal projects. 


Suggested Skills 



- Distributed Systems
- Operating Systems 
- Cloud Computing 
- Software Engineering 
- Data Structures and Algorithms 
- Technical Problem-Solving 


As part of the application process for this role, after an initial qualifications review, candidates are required to successfully complete the HackerRank online code challenge. Instructions for completion of the code challenge will be sent to you if your application is selected to move forward in the process.



LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.



The pay range for this role is $45 to $55. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.



The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.



Additional Information


Equal Opportunity Statement 


We seek candidates with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. LinkedIn considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

About Amplify

Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit Amplify.com http://amplify.com.


CREATE AN IMPACT BY SHAPING THE WORLD OF EDUCATION!

Amplify is seeking a motivated and technically driven Software Engineering Intern to join our team this summer and help us build robust, scalable, and innovative digital experiences for the educators, students, and families who use our cutting-edge educational products. This paid, remote 10-week internship offers the chance to make a real impact on products used by millions of students and teachers.

If you're comfortable with software development, problem-solving, and coding best practices, and you're genuinely curious about how technology can transform learning outcomes, this could be a perfect fit for you. The ideal candidates will love building clean, efficient, and impactful software, bring an eager, collaborative energy to your work, and feel excited to contribute to the engineering systems and product features that power K–12 learning at scale.

Though remote, interns will join a 2-day in-person experience at Amplify HQ in Brooklyn, NY. Throughout the program, interns will engage with Amplify's culture via product demos, team-building activities, and engagement initiatives, plus grow through a virtual speaker series featuring Amplify executives, additional product demos, and dedicated mentorship.

While our summer intern roles are remote positions, interns must be authorized to work in the US, reside in the US for the internship's duration, and be available full-time for the entire program, June 7 – August 13, 2027.

Key responsibilities may include:

 - Support the design, development, and testing of software features and enhancements across Amplify's web and mobile product suite

 - Help identify and resolve bugs, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt to improve product quality and reliability

 - Assist with code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and deployment pipelines to ensure high-quality software delivery

 - Contribute to technical documentation, engineering wikis, API specifications, and internal developer resources

 - Track and resolve issues in project management and version control systems to support sprint goals and release timelines

 - Participate in product demos, sprint ceremonies, and Engineering/Product Manager meetings to build knowledge of Amplify's technology stack and development practices


WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

 - Direct exposure to software engineering tools, frameworks, and best practices used in EdTech

 - Real-world engineering challenges that affect educators, students, and families

 - Collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Design teams across the organization

 - Contributions to meaningful feature development and product improvements in a mission-driven environment

 - Mentorship from industry professionals at the forefront of software engineering in education

 - Exposure to Frontend Engineering, Backend Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, and API Development

 - Hands-on training in a fast-paced, agile environment

 - Opportunities to help shape the performance, scalability, and reliability of educational products used by millions of users


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS FOR THIS AMPLIFY INTERNSHIP:

 - Education: Current enrollment in an undergraduate or graduate degree program, returning to school in Fall 2027

 - Full-time availability to participate from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Ability to synthesize information, identify themes, and communicate insights clearly

 - Knowledge of and interest in the K–12 education technology field


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR SOFTWARE ENGINEERING INTERNS:

 - Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar

 - Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js; or backend frameworks such as Node.js, Django, or Spring

 - Background in software development through coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions, or prior internships

 - Interest in cloud computing, DevOps, API development, distributed systems, or platform engineering

 - Understanding of software design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming principles

Amplify is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  Amplify makes employment decisions based on qualifications and merit, and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status.

Amplify is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans.  If you have a disability and need an accommodation in connection with the application or hiring process, please email hiringaccommodations@amplify.com.

If you are selected for employment, a background check will be required.  As required by state and local laws and district policies, you may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, such as fingerprinting.

Amplify is an E-Verify participant.

Our drive and control technologies ensure efficient, powerful, and safe movement in machines and systems of any size. We inspire our customers with intelligent components, tailored system solutions, and services – from fully connected applications to the factory of the future. Bosch Rexroth is dedicated to making the world a better place through innovation and technology. We are looking for associates who will take on our customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found and who will thrive in a face-paced, collaborative, and exciting environment.

We are seeking a motivated and talented Embedded AI Software Engineering Intern/Co-op to join our team for the summer. As an intern, you will work on cutting-edge embedded AI and computer vision applications for mobile machines, with a focus on optimizing AI models and real-time processing pipelines for deployment on embedded hardware.
 This role provides hands-on experience developing, deploying, profiling, and optimizing AI-powered vision systems on resource-constrained embedded platforms. You will work closely with our software engineering team to improve inference performance, reduce processing latency, and maximize hardware utilization while maintaining real-time system performance.
 Responsibilities 
 
• Collaborate with the software development team to develop and optimize embedded AI and computer vision applications for mobile machines. 
• Deploy, benchmark, and optimize AI models for execution on embedded targets, including platforms equipped with hardware AI accelerators. 
• Optimize real-time video processing and AI inference pipelines to improve throughput, reduce latency, and minimize CPU, GPU, and memory utilization. 
• Profile and troubleshoot on-target performance bottlenecks involving image acquisition, preprocessing, inference, postprocessing, and video output. 
• Explore AI model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, and hardware-specific acceleration to improve inference efficiency. 
• Develop and optimize software components in C/C++ for embedded Linux and real-time operating systems. 
• Integrate AI models with camera systems, sensor inputs, and embedded communication interfaces. 
• Develop testing and benchmarking tools to evaluate model accuracy, execution time, memory consumption, and end-to-end pipeline performance. 
• Document software architecture, optimization strategies, performance results, and implementation details. 
• Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and technical discussions.

Minimum Qualifications 
 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical field. 
• Familiarity with C/C++ programming. 
• Fundamental understanding of embedded systems and software development. 
• Basic knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computer vision concepts. 
• Familiarity with Linux development environments. 
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Preferred Qualifications 
 
• Experience deploying AI or computer vision models on embedded hardware. 
• Familiarity with AI frameworks and deployment tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorFlow Lite, or ONNX. 
• Experience optimizing neural networks through quantization, model compression, or hardware-specific inference acceleration. 
• Familiarity with embedded AI accelerators, GPUs, or NPUs, including platforms such as Texas Instruments TDA4. 
• Experience with real-time video processing frameworks such as GStreamer, OpenCV, or similar technologies. 
• Experience with embedded Linux, QNX, or other real-time operating systems. 
• Familiarity with performance profiling tools and optimization techniques for CPU, GPU, memory, and system-level bottlenecks. 
• Knowledge of image processing, object detection, or semantic segmentation models. 
• Experience with embedded communication protocols such as CAN or Ethernet. 
• Familiarity with cross-compilation, hardware debugging, and on-target software development.

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.

Are you a talented Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science student, registered at a Dutch education institution, and are eager to deepen your experience in Data Engineering and Cloud Engineering?
 
 At ING’s Data Management & Personalization department you will be able to take your expertise to the next level and make maximum use of your knowledge while working in a friendly and dynamic atmosphere. We are looking for a motivated intern to join our team and contribute to the automation of data ingestion workflows within our Analytics Application Platform (AAP). As an intern, you will work on developing a centralized request interface (portal or form-based UI) using Python, Azure DevOps, Power Automate, Oracle database(or BigQuery), and supporting backend workflows that automate validation, request handling, approvals, and tracking which integrates well with Google Cloud Platform and Nifi. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to build a scalable and user-friendly solution. As Advanced Analytics Platform product, we aspire to empower the ING analytics community to enable them to get maximal value out of ING’s data in a short-time-to-market manner by means of a safe, secure & compliant Cloud platform for exploration and exploitation purposes while respecting ING’s IT risk compliance, policies and standards, and other laws, rules and regulations.
 
 What you will do 
 
• Use your engineer skills to design and implement a scalable user-friendly interface
 
• Collaborate closely with data engineers, data scientists, and platform teams
 
• Develop automation workflows for request handling
 
• Implementation of validation, notifications, and tracking
 
• Document the solution, including how-to guides and onboarding materials
 
• Participation in user acceptance testing and rollout readiness
 
• Alignment with stakeholders on the implementation acceptance including the Data Science community and Optimus squad
 
 Your skills 
 
• Have an understanding of using Python, Azure DevOps, Power Automate, Oracle database(or BigQuery).
 
• Experience with back-end development, as you will contribute to backend processes that handle: Input validation, Metadata capture and standardization, Request submission and approval workflows
 
• You know how to write documentation, including how-to guides and onboarding materials
 
• Understanding of implementing notifications and tracking mechanisms for request lifecycle status
 
• An understanding of integration with existing data platforms such as NiFi, Google Cloud Platform, and Oracle
 
• Knowledge of Support logging, monitoring, and audit trail implementation
 
• Experience back-end development
 
• Independent mind-set and flexible attitude
 
• You can contribute proactive in the process of developing
 
 Rewards and benefits 
 This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
 
 You’ll also benefit from:

• Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
 
• An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

• Becoming part of a solid business network and be able to continuously grow as a professional while also working on your personal development

 Questions? 
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.
 
 About our internships 
 Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
 Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career

jd:
About the Role

 Turn your classroom learning into real-world impact with H&R Block’s Embark 2027 Summer Internship Program, open to students studying Computer Science and Software Engineering . This 11-week paid internship offers meaningful, real-world experience that aligns with your field of study while making a valuable impact on our organization.

 The Embark 2027 Summer Internship runs from May 17, 2027 – July 30, 2027. 

 You’ll work at our corporate headquarters in the heart of downtown Kansas City’s Power & Light District, where you’re just steps, or a streetcar ride, away from incredible restaurants, entertainment, and city energy.
